name: Japanese Type 87 Rcv
axis_orientation: Rear-end is the engine compartment, front-end is the turret and gun
operating_principle: The Type 87 is a 6x6 armoured reconnaissance and patrol vehicle that uses a combination of armour, mobility, and firepower to perform its mission. It is equipped with a 25mm cannon and a 7.62mm machine gun, and has a top speed of 100 km/h.

components.description: The main structural body of the vehicle, providing protection for the crew and housing the engine, transmission, and other vital systems.
A two-man power-operated turret that mounts the 25mm cannon and 7.62mm machine gun, providing firepower and protection for the crew.
The engine and transmission system that powers the vehicle, providing mobility and propulsion.
The system that transmits power from the engine to the wheels, providing traction and mobility.
The system that supports the vehicle's weight and provides a smooth ride, allowing for stable and controlled movement.
The protective plating that covers the vehicle, providing protection for the crew from small arms fire and shell splinters.
The windows and observation blocks that provide visibility for the crew, allowing them to observe their surroundings.
Additional armour plating that can be added to the vehicle to provide extra protection, such as slat or cage screens.
